task: Assess whether the report-name value controls the child parser and creates a security vulnerability.
facts: post_report is exposed to untrusted remote users and runs as a service account.
Users may request a report by name, but may not choose an output file.
The service account can overwrite its configuration under /srv/config.
There is no earlier input validation.
The report-name value is exactly --output=/srv/config/runtime.json and reaches renderer as one string.
